items.description: A Party that disputes a matter under the Agreement must notify the other Parties as soon as reasonably practicable with details of the dispute.
items.span_text: in the event that a Party disputes a matter arising in connection with this Agreement that Party shall notify the other Parties as soon as reasonably practicable with details of the dispute
items.trigger: in the event that a Party disputes a matter arising in connection with this Agreement

items.description: After a dispute notice is received, the Parties must meet within ten Business Days to try to resolve the dispute in good faith.
items.span_text: all of the Parties shall meet within ten (10) Business Days of receipt of such notice in order to try and resolve the dispute in good faith

items.description: The parties must share equally the arbitrator's fees and the administrative fees of the arbitration.
items.span_text: the parties shall equally share the arbitrator’s fees and the administrative fees of the arbitration
